newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary c.bank says its one-yr bond yield 20.25pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary c.bank says its one-yr bond yield 20.25pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on its Reuters page on Wednesday that the yield on its domestic one-year bonds which it would begin to issue on Friday, was 20.25 percent.
The yield is the same as the interest rate of the central bank's twelve-month deposit facility which the NBH abolished earlier on Thursday.
This will be the first time that the NBH enters the domestic market with its own bonds.
The NBH said earlier that the yields to be offered on the bonds will give indications for the markets on the yield levels which the central bank regarded appropriate.
The central bank said it would issue its own bonds when the amount of government securities it had was not sufficient for its potential open market operations.
